column12: NG TB Community and Facility Referral Register
column13:
Logical model for the Nigeria National Tuberculosis and Leprosy Control
Programme Tuberculosis Referral Register for Community and Facility.
One model instance represents one site-level monthly referral register
and contains repeatable client entries covering demographics, referral
date and reason, receiving facility, confirmation of TB, treatment
initiation and remarks.
Identifier assigned to the community and facility TB referral register or its electronic equivalent.
Reference to the site maintaining the referral register, when available.
Name of the site maintaining the TB referral register.
State in which the reporting site is located.
Local Government Area in which the reporting site is located.
Administrative ward in which the reporting site is located.
Monthly reporting period represented by the Month and Year fields in the source register.
One client-level referral row in the community and facility TB referral register.
